comparison.objective: Replace a ratchet-dispenser cartridge; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Release/access manipulation, cartridge extraction, keyed placement and ratchet re-engagement versus recessed-tool alignment, collar tuning and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Replacement cartridge seated and dispenser operating without loss or damage versus two safe stops with locked setting. Candidate omits numeric rebound/overload/drift limits.
comparison.reason: Module replacement and mechanism re-engagement are different from tuning a continuously adjustable dissipative component.
